launcher.notes: KINETRIX LAUNCHER 3.0.5 - LAUNCH BLOCKER FIXED + TASKBAR ICON STAYS. A stale filename inside the update manifest (kinetrix-3.16.1.jar listed under the mod-v3.16.2 release) made the pre-launch client update fail with HTTP 404 after 3 retries and blocked every launch - the manifest is now cross-checked against its own version, a mismatching filename is repaired from the release's real asset list, and if the download URL is ever rejected (or a checksum disagrees) the launcher re-resolves the newest release from the actual GitHub release assets before giving up, so a bad manifest can no longer stop you from playing (already fixed live on the channel too - today's 404 is gone even on v3.0.4). The taskbar icon no longer disappears: with close-after-launch the window is hidden while the game runs, and on Windows re-showing it that way could drop the taskbar button - the window is now restored and the taskbar entry is re-registered every time it reappears. Everything from 3.0.4 is unchanged: the hard pre-launch client gate, Modrinth + CurseForge browser, Microsoft sign-in, Quick Play, cosmetics locker and full crash doctor.

notes: Kinetrix Client 3.34.0 'New Base UI' - the full port of the updated base client: the whole new UI wave rebranded and integrated - new design tokens, glass menus (drawMenuGlass/button glass), Figtree font family + Lucide icon font, new main-menu panorama with the wider-FOV glass camera, Box dialog system hosting main menu / mods / settings / cosmetics / friends / HUD editor, restyled esc / pause / disconnected / world select / server browser / profiles / report / resource packs / onboarding, friends screen gains group rename + group icons + chat context menu, account dropdown box mode, settings panel box style + dense rows + fold-under-toggle + full crosshair editor (centre pixel + focus mode), HUD gains 1% / 0.1% low FPS rows + joined widget groups + a far more capable HUD editor (multi-select, band select, group drag, rename groups, conjoined groups, undo/redo), tab overlay columns follow gamemode with per-game column toggles + duels prefix per mode, cosmetics + cloak library + skin changer + accessories restyled with custom head items, and brand-new features: Texture Mix (blend resource packs live) + Mixed Pack Builder, Spin Boost, Harness Focus, Mod Guard (warns when installed mods overlap built-ins), Frame Lows, Page Snapshot, File Drop, Join World, hide leather armour (with on-self option), arrow flight facing, inventory doll clipping, stale F3 guard, toast kinds, HUD layout snapshots and profile editing. Everything from 3.33.0 'Hand-Painted Capes' (124 capes) and 3.32.0 'Cosmetic Forge' (140 free cosmetics) is unchanged.
